_keys_note: Discrete(8) compass action space: 0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW. Arrows map to the cardinals; NetHack's y/u/b/n map to the diagonals. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N), so a real-time loop would auto-walk north. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: Explore the room and step onto the down-staircase
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / U        move diagonally  NW / NE
B / N        move diagonally  SW / SE
